name: Among the Distant Stars
source:
Dara Arreal is a White Mage, a practitioner of healing magic renowned for her rare abilities. When the world of Mitalia faces a devastating pandemic, she is dispatched to the planet with her friend Derek as a final hope for the dying population. But as soon as they enter deep space, a powerful surge of magic rips through a nearby constellation. After recognizing a life force, they locate a shell within the energy pulse and bring it on board. Inside, they find an unconscious man at its core, barely clinging to life and in dire need of aid. As a healer, Dara is compelled to save anyone she can, but the dangerous aura she senses from the man torments her thoughts. Who is he? And why was he floating through space? While these questions haunt her conscience, Dara can't escape the premonition that her life has been changed forever.

[Edited from [url=https://katta.itch.io/among-the-distant-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
达拉·阿雷尔（Dara Arreal）是一名白魔法师，她是一名治疗魔法的实践者，以其罕见的能力而闻名。当米塔利亚世界面临毁灭性的流行病时，她和她的朋友德里克被派往这个星球，作为垂死人口的最后希望。但当他们进入深空时，一股强大的魔法浪潮撕裂了附近的星座。在识别出生命力后，他们在能量脉冲中找到一个外壳并将其带上船。在里面，他们发现一个昏迷不醒的人在其核心，勉强维持生命并迫切需要援助。作为一名治疗师，达拉被迫拯救任何人，但她从这个男人身上感受到的危险气息折磨着她的思绪。他是谁？为什么他会漂浮在太空中？虽然这些问题困扰着达拉的良心，但她无法摆脱自己的生活已被永远改变的预感。
